questions.fact: An axolotl can regrow a lost leg, and even parts of its heart and brain.

questions.prompt: Which of these US states border Canada?
questions.fact: Thirteen US states touch the Canadian border, counting the ones that meet it across the Great Lakes.

questions.prompt: How many passengers sailed to America on the Mayflower?
questions.fact: 102 passengers in 1620, crammed below deck for more than two months.

questions.prompt: How long is a giraffe's neck, in metres?
questions.fact: A giraffe's neck has seven bones in it, the same number as yours. Each one is just much longer.

questions.hint: He was a Scottish scientist who noticed mould killing bacteria in a dish he had left out.
questions.fact: Alexander Fleming found it in 1928 after coming back from a holiday to a messy lab.

questions.prompt: What is the name of Batman's butler?
questions.fact: Michael Caine played Alfred in all three of Christopher Nolan's Batman films.
